Shared notes on your desk and a notifications tray.

### 🚀 Features
- **Notifications tray.**
- Notes shared with you sit on your desk, with a "Shared with me" filter.
- Note cards size to their note's length.

### 🐛 Fixes
- Editor menus respond to clicks inside the open note.

**Upgrade:** `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d` · **Full changelog:** [v0.1.16...v0.1.17](https://github.com/lyfie-org/papyra/compare/v0.1.16...v0.1.17)
